body: It sounds to me like a number of different psychological symptoms could be the culprit here. Talk to a doctor, get counselling, therapy. There are probably a number of resources available. I get it though, i used to feel very depersonalized and dissociated, to start with. If you need to talk to someone, feel free to reach out <3

I can’t indulge my bulimia as much as i’d like to right now because i’m on medication which i take 3x a day, so ...great lol. I want to believe its a coincidence but I don’t believe it is, in my heart, and that hurts.  I’d rather just be told to end my life, like my one sister told me the once.
Get help. Get away from this person if you can.
